description: This file defines the class HTML_Template_Flexy_Compiler_Regex, which is part of a template compilation system in the Flexy engine. It includes methods for compiling templates and applying filters using regex-based filter classes.

classes.name: HTML_Template_Flexy_Compiler_Regex
classes.description: A class responsible for regex-based template compilation and filtering within the Flexy templating system.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Reads a template file, applies pre and post filters, and writes the compiled template to a file.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies a set of regex-based filters to input content, dynamically loading filter classes as needed.
